emails.subject: The big three: organic, AI, and local search
emails.content:
Hi {{ subscriber.first_name | default: "there" }},

Being found online involves more than one search surface.

Organic search: the regular Google results for your practice and market. This is where we measure the keyword boost.

AI search: how your firm is represented in answers from tools such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews.

Local search: your Google Business Profile, Maps, and the local pack.

Fully managed work covers all three. Each needs its own work and measurement. An organic ranking change does not automatically create an AI recommendation or a Maps result.

We will cover the scope and pricing on the call.

Bilal

Boost only means you choose the keywords and URLs, with a minimum of 5 keywords, and manage the rest of your SEO yourself.

Managed is the more complete option. Boost only can fit when you already have someone handling the other work. I will cover the exact scope and pricing on our call.

There is one other piece: your website needs to convert the traffic. If the site is holding that back, we can discuss a custom build as a separate option.
